title: [BUG] TODO list stops working after compact
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x ] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version:  Latest as of 5-11-25 
- Operating System: Ubuntu 24.04 
- Terminal:  Bash

## Bug Description
Claude forgets todo list when I suspect context hits limit 

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Create long todo list (15+) 
2. Use Claude


## Expected Behavior
Todo list stays persistent and not lost/forgotten.

## Actual Behavior
Todo list lost/forgotten

## Additional Context
No
author: myevolve
